$comment: BD1 moment finder (plan docs/plan/2026-11-21-beatdrop-montages.md section 5 BD1, D413, D414). The CODM numbers services/clip/moments.py uses to time gunshots, hits and kills, scope in and out, flicks, slides and jumps, and third-person shots to the frame. Boxes are fractions of the full 16:9 game frame (x0/y0 top-left, x1/y1 bottom-right); radii are fractions of the frame height. Every value is the agent's first proposal, tuned only on synthetic fixtures (tests/py/test_moments.py). Status unverified until checked on hand-labelled stretches of the user's own footage (labels with timestamps only).
